messages:
nina_fin: FYI Orion Metrics INV-53344 for $4,320 hit AP with MISSING_PO. Vendor notes this invoice nets a previous credit memo CM-121 (they applied it on their side) and references contract C-OM-2024, no PO. Can we route?

leo_proc: Please attach invoice + credit memo screenshot. If they netted a credit we need documentation or vendor reissue showing PO ref.

tara_ap: AP match output: `MATCH_FAIL: no_po_on_invoice; netted_credit_detected: CM-121; candidates: [PO-1200] but not referenced`.

sam_ops: Work tied to PO-1200 (eng trial) only. Procurement didn't issue a second PO; vendor should have used PO-1200.

leo_proc: Options: ask vendor to reissue invoice referencing PO-1200 and showing the credit line, OR move to Non-PO Review with manual GL allocation. For payrun Monday prefer reissue.

procure-bot: Ticket PR-5099 created: "Orion INV-53344 - missing PO & netted credit CM-121" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: Invoice INV-53344 moved to Pending Vendor Action. Hold timer 72h. Attach reissued invoice or credit memo to PR-5099.

nina_fin: pinged vendor; they say their AR system auto-applied CM-121. They'll reissue if we confirm PO-1200 reference. I've asked them to reissue by EOD tomorrow.

leo_proc: I'll also request procurement to confirm PO-1200 is the intended target and update PR-5099. If vendor can't reissue we will accept manual exception with Tara's GL split and Sam's sign-off.

tara_ap: provisional GL: charge line->GL 5705 (platform evaluation); credit netting recorded to GL 2201 (vendor credits). Approver: tara_ap.

sam_ops: confirming acceptance of deliverables; attaching acceptance email to PR-5099 to expedite.

nina_fin: Closing loop when PR-5099 has reissued invoice OR manual exception and payment record. :white_check_mark:
